head: codex/101-github-route-guardrail
title: [v0.92][tools] Enforce repo-native GitHub lifecycle routes
body:
Closes #101

Defines one fail-closed Rust owner for each covered C-SDLC GitHub lifecycle surface and prohibits connector or raw-gh write fallback.

Adds focused deterministic guardrails that:
- keep root and boundary route-owner policy aligned
- classify connector 403 failures without blaming the operator token or authorizing fallback
- exercise default and configured token-file precedence with redacted failures
- require all four route-owner binaries in the verified installation inventory
- retain the dedicated proof command in the authoritative boundary

Validation:
- cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml -- --check
- cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
- cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate_github_route_policy (3 passed)
- git diff --check

Independent exact-head review at 3a6913d5774edd645c2ed0872154afc409953478 found no actionable findings. Four earlier focused coverage and CI findings are retained as fixed.

No token contents are retained, printed, copied, or committed.
